title: Angampora
author_or_institution: Ministry of Youth & Sports, Sri Lanka
author_institution: Ministry of Youth & Sports, Sri Lanka
scope: Current institutional description of Angampora; angam hand-to-hand combat, illangam weapons, meditation and associated traditions
limitations: Useful for the current recognized practice and terminology, not for proving multi-millennial origin legends or exact colonial measures.

title: Preservation and Promotion of 'Angam Shilpa' — Cabinet decision 2019-03-06
author_or_institution: Cabinet Office, Government of Sri Lanka
author_institution: Cabinet Office, Government of Sri Lanka
scope: Cabinet approval to preserve/promote Angam Shilpa, annul what the decision describes as an 1817 British colonial Gazette ban, and recognize the art as national heritage
limitations: Primary evidence for a 2019 government decision and its stated historical framing; it is not itself the alleged 1817 Gazette and therefore does not independently prove the original ban text or penalties.

title: Conservation and Promotion of Angam Martial Art — Cabinet decision 2022-06-13
author_or_institution: Cabinet Office, Government of Sri Lanka
author_institution: Cabinet Office, Government of Sri Lanka
scope: Cabinet records that the 2019 approval to lift the claimed colonial ban had not yet produced the relevant Gazette and again approves publication in order to conserve/protect Angampora
limitations: Strong evidence for current state policy and public-memory framing; still not a facsimile or archival citation of the alleged 1817 ban.

title: A Sketch of the Constitution of the Kandyan Kingdom
date: 1833; based on D'Oyly's account of the late Kandyan government
scope: Contemporary-near account of Kandyan court and administrative institutions; contextual anchor for the organized martial culture of the late kingdom
limitations: Retained as contextual anchor only in this run. No Angampora-specific proposition is promoted from it without a directly located passage.
